source.note: hand-written; reading notes with opinions, a preference and a generic observation

units.text: Finished The Remains of the Day last night, Ishiguro. Loved it, genuinely one of the best things I've read in years, the restraint of it. Next I want Klara and the Sun, same author, Marta recommended it ages ago.

I notice I read fiction on paper and everything else as audio. Non-fiction I just can't sit with, but walking and listening, that works, so, keep doing that, buy the non-fiction on Audible and the novels at Bookarest.
There's that thing about fiction building empathy, reading about other minds, I think that's basically true, people who read novels are probably better at, you know, seeing other people. Anyway.
Book club is the twenty-eighth, at Zosia's this time, and the book is Drive Your Plow by Tokarczuk, which I have not started, so, start it this week.

expected.content: The user finished Kazuo Ishiguro's The Remains of the Day on January 10, 2026 and loved it; they plan to read Klara and the Sun next, which Marta recommended.
The user reads fiction on paper (bought at Bookarest) and non-fiction as audiobooks on Audible while walking.
The user's book club meets on January 28, 2026 at Zosia's; the book is Olga Tokarczuk's Drive Your Plow, which the user has not started yet.
